# Merchandising attribute enrichment with AI


Improve catalog quality with AI that automatically extracts and enriches product attributes, corrects inaccurate metadata, and standardizes inconsistent labels. Merchandising attribute enrichment in[Grid Dynamics’ Merchandising Experience Platform (MXP) supports more accurate product discovery](https://www.griddynamics.com/solutions/merchandising-experience-platform) while keeping merchandisers in control of catalog updates.


Watch the demo to see how AI:


- Fills missing attributes, including color, material, style, occasion, and pattern.
- Identifies and corrects discrepancies between product images and existing metadata.
- Publishes high-confidence updates and holds low-confidence changes for human review.


Merchandisers can inspect the reasoning behind each AI-generated value, review independent validation details, and check confidence scores.


MXP brings catalog quality,[search](https://www.griddynamics.com/solutions/vertex-ai-search-for-retail-starter-kit) , browse, and recommendations into one workspace. Enriched product data helps shoppers and[agentic commerce shopping agents find and understand your products](https://www.griddynamics.com/solutions/agentic-commerce-readiness-assessment) , with less manual catalog cleanup.


Watch the demo to see automated enrichment and review controls in action. Schedule a live demo to explore how MXP Attribute Enrichment could address your catalog challenges.
